behavior: Constant, not env: the current durable run-state schema version is 1; legacy is 0; min supported is 0; workflow-app schema is 1.
createRunPaths(runDir) returns 16 paths: state.json, report.md, and dirs tasks results dispatches artifacts commits nodes feedback audit workers candidates multi-agent blackboard topologies.
The shell ensureRunDirs makes runDir plus the 13 sub-dirs recursively; missing optional path fields fall back to path.join(runDir, name).
loadRunFromCwd(runId, cwd) reads <cwd>/.cw/runs/<runId>/state.json via dry-run migration; empty id throws 'Missing run id'; unsupported throws 'Unsupported CW run state: <errors joined by ; >'.
Run id must match /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$/ and not be '.' or '..'; refusal message: Unsafe <context>: <json> must be a single path segment ([A-Za-z0-9._:-], not '.' or '..').
safeFileName replaces every run of chars outside [a-zA-Z0-9_.:-] with one underscore; used for node, snapshot, and summary file names.
Every JSON file this core writes is JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus one trailing newline.
writeJson writes to <file>.tmp.<pid>.<counter> then renameSync over the target; a failed rename removes the temp and rethrows; readers see old bytes or new bytes, never torn.
With { durable: true } the file fd is fsynced before rename and the parent dir fd after (dir fsync best-effort); used for state.json via saveCheckpoint.
readJson throws 'File not found: <file>' when absent and 'Invalid JSON in <file>: <message>' on parse error.
saveCheckpoint sets run.updatedAt to now-ISO, then under withFileLock(state.json) writes the whole run durably; state.json is the single source of truth.
compactCheckpoint deletes the 7 keys nodes contracts feedback workers sandboxProfiles candidates candidateSelections when each is an empty array, saves only if any stripped, returns the count.
Open O_APPEND, write, fsync, close — append survives power loss (used by the trust-audit event log).
Advisory lock beside the target: content '<pid>@<ISO>\n'; O_EXCL create; stale steal after 30000 ms mtime; 240 tries with 25 ms sleep.
After fn() the lock body is re-read; if it no longer starts with '<pid>@' the holder throws the stolen-lock error and does NOT delete the thief's lock; release only when still owned.
No lock after 240 tries throws 'could not acquire file lock for <targetPath>'.
realResolve realpaths the deepest existing ancestor and re-joins the missing tail; isContainedPath realpaths both sides then compares equality or prefix+sep.
hashArtifactFile sets sha256 ('sha256:'+64 hex) and sizeBytes from the file; a missing file is silently skipped, never a throw.
state check <run-id> [--state PATH] [--write] [--cwd PATH] prints the StateMigrationReport as 2-space JSON; --write persists only when writeRequired and not unsupported.
cw state check sets exit code 1 when report.status === 'unsupported'.

Keys: status statePath detectedSchemaVersion currentSchemaVersion supportedSchemaVersions{min,max} dryRun writeRequired changes[] warnings[] errors[]; status is current|migrated|normalized|unsupported.
Run state without a schemaVersion key detects as 0 (legacy); a non-integer schemaVersion detects as +Infinity and is refused as newer-than-runtime.

Non-object input, version < 0, or version > 1 gives status 'unsupported' with an exact error and never writes; errors: 'Run state must be a JSON object.', 'Unsupported run-state schemaVersion <d>.', 'Run state schemaVersion <d> is newer than this CW runtime (1).'
findMigrationPath is BFS over forward edges plus declared reverse edges; no path gives 'no migration path from schemaVersion <from> to <to>' and unsupported.
RUN_STATE_MIGRATIONS has one step 0->1 which only sets a default schemaVersion=1; its reverse deletes schemaVersion only when it equals 1.

normalizeRunState fills: id from run-dir basename else 'unknown-run'; createdAt/updatedAt from each other else '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'; cwd three dirs above runDir; loopStage 'interpret' (bad value overwritten); workflow.limits {maxAgents:8,maxConcurrentAgents:4}; all 16 paths; audit default paths; multiAgent/blackboard/topologies schemaVersion 1 skeletons; each change recorded.
Missing phases are derived from tasks grouped by task.phase (default 'Workflow'); phase id is the slugified name; status 'completed' only when every member task is completed.
A run without a collaboration key loads unchanged (the key is not added); when present it is normalized to schemaVersion 1 with approvals/comments/handoffs arrays.
Final status: any error -> unsupported; detected < current -> migrated; changes > 0 -> normalized; else current. writeRequired = changes.length > 0.

Post-normalize check emits: 'Missing required run-state field: <key>.', 'Expected schemaVersion 1; found <v>.', '<key> must be an object.', '<key> must be an array.' against the run-state-schema key lists.

Reverse migration refuses target below min ('Target schemaVersion <t> is below the minimum supported 0.') or above current, and warns 'Destructive reverse change at <path>: removed <json>' when a reverse step removes data.

REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS (13), REQUIRED_ARRAY_KEYS (phases tasks dispatches commits), REQUIRED_RECORD_KEYS (workflow paths multiAgent blackboard topologies), OPTIONAL_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS (13) are the single field-list source, gated by validate-run-state-schema.js.
schema-version-inventory.json names one canonical *_SCHEMA_VERSION definition source for each separate schema domain; unknown, duplicate, moved, and stale entries fail closed.
createStateNode gives schemaVersion 1, status 'pending', now timestamps, and empty inputs/outputs/artifacts/evidence/errors/parents/children.
A node minted without an id gets '<kind>-'+first 16 hex of sha256(stableStringify({kind,loopStage,contractId,inputs,outputs})); same content collapses to one id; no clock or random.

Legal transitions: pending->running|blocked|failed|completed|verified|rejected; running->completed|failed|blocked; completed->verified|rejected|failed; failed->pending|blocked; blocked->pending|failed; verified->committed|rejected; rejected->pending|failed; committed terminal; same->same always.
committed is refused unless the node is exactly verified — a second gate with code 'commit-without-verifier' after the matrix; illegal transitions throw before the node changes.
Contract failures throw PipelineContractError with structured StateNodeError {code,message,at,nodeId?,path?,retryable?,details?}; at defaults to now-ISO.

assertNodeSatisfiesContract checks stage exists, node kind and status accepted, required artifacts present AND file paths exist, required evidence present (id or source match), verifier gate (accepted statuses default ['verified']).
appendRunNode upserts run.nodes in place (replace at same index or push) keeping the array reference and persisted order stable, then writes the node file.
writeRunNode writes each StateNode to <runDir>/nodes/<safeFileName(nodeId)>.json (atomic, non-durable) and returns the path.
recordNodeError returns a new node with status 'failed' and the error appended with defaulted at/nodeId.
linkStateNodes returns parent with child id added to children and child with parent id added to parents, both de-duplicated, fresh updatedAt.

The canonical projected field set is id kind status loopStage inputs outputs artifacts evidence errors parents children contractId metadata — one source shared by snapshots and reclamation tombstones.
snapshotNode persists NodeSnapshot at nodes/snapshots/<safeFileName(nodeId)>/<snapshotId>.json; snapshotId = 'snap-<safe-node-id>-<first 12 hex of raw source fingerprint>'.
replayNodeSnapshot persists NodeReplayRun under .../replays/; replayId = 'replay-<snapshotId>-<first 8 hex of outputFingerprint>'.

sourceFingerprint hashes raw 'node:<id>:<status>:<updatedAt>' plus artifact and evidence id:path lines — any transition flips it; the body is normalized (timestamps/paths scrubbed) so it is byte-stable.
loadNodeSnapshot returns valid|stale|absent: node gone or an artifact path unreadable -> absent (with exact reasons); fingerprint changed -> stale.
replayNodeSnapshot throws NodeSnapshotError 'snapshot-stale' or 'snapshot-absent' unless freshness is valid; never a silent stale replay.

diffNodeSnapshots always emits 8 sections in order status inputs outputs artifacts evidence errors links metadata; links compares {parents,children}; change is same|added|removed|changed by normalized-bytes compare; non-same sections carry baseline and candidate.

Verify diffs a fresh snapshot vs the replay body; findings are {id:'drift:<section>',severity:'error',...}; source gone gives pass false with finding id 'source-absent'; pass true only with zero findings.
readNodeSnapshot/readNodeReplay scan every per-node snapshot dir, shape-validate the parsed JSON, and throw 'snapshot-not-found'/'replay-not-found' when absent.
CLI node family prints pretty JSON of NodeSnapshot/NodeSnapshotDiff/NodeReplayRun/NodeReplayVerdict; diff takes baseline and candidate snapshot ids as positionals 2 and 3.
cw node verify sets exit code 1 when the verdict does not pass.

Default thresholds: graphNodes 40, graphEdges 60, blackboardMessages 25, blackboardRecords 40, collapseBucket 6, totalRecords 80; compactionRecommended when any reason fires; reasons are exact sorted strings like 'graph has <n> nodes (> 40)'.
GRAPH_VIEWS = full compact critical-path failures evidence trust topology blackboard candidate commit-gate.

Never collapsed: critical-path ids, nodes with status failed|blocked|rejected|conflicting, reasoning-critical nodes, failure-linked nodes; only kinds blackboard-message blackboard-context agent-membership worker score blackboard-snapshot agent-role are collapsible.

Buckets smaller than collapseBucket (6) stay expanded except in critical-path view where off-path nodes collapse into 'critical-context:<kind>' buckets; synthetic node id is '<runId>:summary:<slug(key)>' with label '<key> (<n> collapsed)'.
Output nodes sorted by kind then id, edges by from/to/label, synthetic nodes by id; edges into collapsed members re-point to the synthetic node; internal edges dropped; duplicates de-duplicated.

summarizeBlackboardDigest returns 12 id-sorted lists (topicRollups threadSummaries unresolvedQuestions conflicts decisions artifacts adoptedEvidence missingEvidence policyViolations judgeRationale recentChanges highSignal); record id 'blackboard-digest[:<boardId>]'.

refreshStateExplosionSummaries writes each record to summaries/<safeFileName(id)>.json, the MultiAgentSummaryIndex (id 'multi-agent-summary-index') to summaries/index.json, and the report to summaries/state-explosion-report.json.

Report freshness: no persisted index -> absent; fingerprint mismatch or any stale scope -> stale; stale/absent flips nextAction to 'cw summary refresh <runId>'; a stale show records trust-audit event summary.stale decision 'failed'.
refreshStateExplosionSummaries records trust-audit event kind 'summary.refresh' decision 'recorded' source 'runtime-derived' actor 'cw' with scope list and counts.
maybeCompactRun refreshes summaries only when computeStateSize recommends compaction; every error is silently swallowed — a state mutation never fails for compaction.
loadStateExplosionSummaryIndex returns undefined for a missing file, bad JSON, or an id other than 'multi-agent-summary-index'.

summary refresh writes summaries + report.md + checkpoint; summary show loads index, builds report, checkpoints; --json prints the record, else formatStateExplosionReport text; wrong verb throws the usage line.

Human output panels in fixed order: State Explosion Report header, Freshness, State Size, Compact Graph, Blackboard Digest, Critical Path, Failures / Blockers, Evidence Digest, Trust / Policy Digest, Hidden Source Records, Expansion Commands, Next Action; collapse line 'Graph compacted: <n> nodes collapsed into <m> summary nodes'.

normalizeStateExplosionForEval emits 6 sections (summaryFreshness compactGraphShape blackboardDigest criticalPath evidenceDigest expansionRefs) as key-sorted JSON lines with run-id stripped from critical-path ids.
fingerprintStrings sorts its inputs, hashes JSON.stringify of the sorted array, and returns 'sha256:' + first 32 hex; fingerprintRecords fingerprints '<id>:<status>' lines.
dominantStatus priority: failed blocked rejected conflicting running pending, else first, else 'completed'; isProtectedStatus is true for failed blocked rejected conflicting.
truncate collapses whitespace and cuts over-80-char strings to 77 + '...'; slug maps chars outside [a-zA-Z0-9._:-] to '-'; unique drops falsy and sorts.
Prints { contracts: [run-state {currentVersion 1, minVersion 0, 1 edge with proof}, workflow-app {currentVersion 1, minVersion 1, edges []}] }.

Target is a file path or run id (resolves .cw/runs/<id>/state.json); prints MigrationVerdict {schemaVersion 1, contract, status, detectedVersion, currentVersion, reachable, chain, changes, errors}; missing target throws 'Migration target not found: <target>'.
cw migration check sets exit code 1 when status is 'unsupported'.

Prints MigrationProof with four booleans (validatesAtCurrent appendOnly idempotent sourceImmutable), pass, sourceHash/resultHash/fingerprint ('sha256:'+64 hex key-sorted), errors; persists the proof to <targetDir>/migration/<first 16 hex>.json append-only (read-only target tolerated).
cw migration prove sets exit code 1 when proof.pass is false.
Selects the migration contract; any value other than 'workflow-app' means 'run-state'.
Exact refusals: below min, newer than runtime, workflow-app not current with no edges, or 'no migration edge from <contract> schemaVersion <v>' — unsupported verdict, no transform, no write.

pass requires validatesAtCurrent AND appendOnly (every source key survives recursively) AND idempotent (re-run gives 0 changes, status current) AND sourceImmutable (stableHash unchanged) AND zero errors; unsupported never transforms.

validateAgainstSchema supports type (arrays, integer, null), const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items; a type mismatch stops deeper checks at that level; unknown declared type never fails; returns string errors, empty = valid.

Exact errors: '<path>: expected type <a|b>, got <t>', '<path>: expected const <json>', '<path>: <json> is not one of <json>', '<path>: missing required property "<key>"', '<path>: additional property "<key>" is not allowed'; paths like $.field[0].

Unsupported keywords ($ref allOf anyOf oneOf not pattern format minimum maximum minLength maxLength minItems maxItems uniqueItems contains if then else) are ignored; only when process.stderr.isTTY a note '[cw] schema at <path>: unsupported keywords ignored: <list>' goes to stderr.

validateWorkerScope/validateNodeSnapshot/validateNodeReplayRun/validateCandidateScore/validateCandidateRecord check schemaVersion===1, required strings, enums, typed arrays; throw RecordValidationError 'Invalid persisted <Type>: <reason>' (code 'record-shape-invalid'); tryValidateCandidateScore returns null instead.

WorkflowRun schema 1: required top keys schemaVersion id createdAt updatedAt cwd workflow inputs loopStage phases tasks dispatches commits paths; optional nodes contracts feedback audit workers sandboxProfiles customSandboxProfiles candidates candidateSelections multiAgent blackboard topologies collaboration.
Normalization defaults state.audit to {schemaVersion 1, eventLogPath <auditDir>/events.jsonl, summaryPath <auditDir>/summary.json, indexPath <auditDir>/index.json}.
cw migration prove appends the MigrationProof beside the target under migration/, never overwriting the source; re-proving the same bytes gives the same fingerprint and file name.
All CLI JSON output is JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + newline on stdout.

normalizeValue drops keys createdAt updatedAt recordedAt selectedAt replayedAt generatedAt, sorts keys, and rewrites strings: timestamps -> '<timestamp>', run dirs -> '<run-dir>', eval dirs -> '<eval-dir>', tmp paths -> '<tmp>'; replayStableStringify = JSON.stringify(normalizeValue(v)).

Exact usage errors: 'Usage: cw state check <run-id> [--state PATH] [--write]', 'Usage: cw migration list|check|prove [target] [--contract run-state|workflow-app]', 'Usage: cw node list|show|graph|snapshot|diff|replay|verify <run-id> [node-id|snapshot-id|replay-id]', 'Usage: cw summary refresh|show <run-id> [--json]'.
